purpose: Teach: 尺度/原題/考案/多種/年版/義務づけ/失格/事業主

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お客様満足度の尺度を見直しましょう
lines.en: Let's review our customer satisfaction metrics.
lines.style: Clear, purposeful opening. Brisk but not rushed. The tone of someone moving through an agenda—organized, ready to listen. Even cadence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品の原題決定は今月中ですね
lines.en: Yes. We need to finalize the new product name by end of month.
lines.style: Attentive, taking notes. Steady pace. Slight upward lift at the end—confirming he's understood the timeline. Responsive without being deferential.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員のアイデアを考案ベースに反映しましょう
lines.en: Let's base the approach on staff suggestions and make sure those are reflected.
lines.style: Measured directive. Slight emphasis on 'staff'—signaling that this is collaborative, not top-down. Calm authority. A beat of pause before the second clause.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。多種多様な分野へ進出します
lines.en: Yes. We're expanding into multiple new sectors.
lines.style: Steady, confirmatory. Slight nod in his voice. Not excited, but assured—like he's already thinking ahead about what that means. Professional tempo.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界年版の最新情報を取り寄せましょう
lines.en: Let's get the latest industry reports pulled together.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact assignment. Efficient tone, no wasted syllables. Brief and clear—assuming competence from the listener. Light closing cadence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。研修参加の義務づけを検討中です
lines.en: Yes. We're looking into making training participation mandatory.
lines.style: Straightforward update. Slight weight on 'mandatory'—acknowledging this is a bigger decision. Unbothered, informative. Even breathing.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 応募者の書類不備は失格対象ですね
lines.en: Incomplete applications are grounds for disqualification, correct?
lines.style: Formal check-in. Light, confirming inflection at the end—not aggressive, just making sure they're aligned. Precise but not cold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。事業主との直接交渉を進めます
lines.en: Yes. I'll move forward with direct negotiations with the business partners.
lines.style: Firm closure. Owned responsibility—'I will'—small note of determination. Even, professional. The natural end of the meeting settling into his voice.
